subject: Tax return cost
body:
Hi,

I'm employed full time (PAYE) but I also have some savings interest and a few dividends from shares, and HMRC have told me I need to do a Self Assessment this year. How much would you charge to do the return for me?

Thanks,
Sarah Patel
07700 900123
reference: A basic Self Assessment return covering employment, savings interest and dividends is from £180 plus VAT. The fee includes checking the figures, filing with HMRC and telling you what to pay and when. Suggest a free 20-minute call to confirm the fee in writing.

subject: Landlord - two flats
body: Hello, I own two buy-to-let flats in Woking and have a day job. What would a tax return cost me? Regards Tom
reference: A return with 1 rental property is £240 and each additional property adds £40, so 2 properties would be £280 plus VAT. We would need rent received, agent statements, mortgage interest statements and receipts for costs.

subject: Quote for ltd company accounts
body:
Good morning,

I run a small IT consultancy through a limited company (just me, no employees, turnover around 90k). Could you give me a price for the annual accounts and corporation tax return? Also do you charge separately for the confirmation statement?

Kind regards,
Priya Nair
Director, Nair Consulting Ltd
reference: Annual accounts and the CT600 are from £750 per year plus VAT. The confirmation statement is £60 plus the £34 Companies House fee. A director's personal return is from £180 if needed.

subject: Bookkeeping
body: Hi there. I have a small plumbing business, roughly 80 transactions a month through the business account. What do you charge for monthly bookkeeping and can you work in Xero? Cheers, James
reference: Bookkeeping is from £95 per month for up to 100 transactions, so 80 a month fits that tier. We work in Xero, QuickBooks Online or FreeAgent. VAT returns would be £60 per quarter on top if needed.

subject: Payroll for 3 staff
body:
Hello,

We are a cafe in Godalming with 3 part-time employees. How much is payroll per month and does that include the submissions to HMRC?

Best wishes,
Lena
reference: Payroll is £25 per month for up to 5 employees, including payslips, RTI submissions to HMRC, P60s and leaver forms. Auto-enrolment pension set-up is £150 one-off if needed.

subject: VAT returns
body: You already do our books. What would it cost to add the quarterly VAT returns? Mo
reference: When we already do the bookkeeping, VAT returns are £60 per quarter plus VAT. We file at least 3 working days before the due date if we have the records by the 10th of the month.

subject: Setting up a limited company
body:
Hi, I'm a freelance graphic designer and I've been told to set up a limited company. How much do you charge to form one and how long does it take?

Rachel
reference: Company formation is £150 including the Companies House fee, and the company is usually registered within 2 working days. A registered office address service is £120 per year if you do not want to use your home address.

subject: One-off advice session
body:
Hi, I don't need a full service, just an hour or so with someone to go through whether I should go limited. What's your hourly rate and is the first chat free?

Thanks
Dev
reference: Ad hoc advice is £110 per hour plus VAT, billed in 15-minute units. The first 20-minute call is free of charge with no obligation.

subject: CIS
body: im a contractor in construction and need monthly CIS returns doing, how much? ben
reference: CIS monthly returns are £35 per month plus VAT, including verification of subcontractors.

subject: Are your prices inc VAT?
body: Quick one - the prices on your website, do they include VAT or is that added on top? Aisha
reference: Our fees are shown excluding VAT; we are VAT registered so VAT at 20% is added to every invoice.

subject: Invoice payment terms
body: Hello, I received your invoice yesterday. How long do I have to pay it, and can I pay by card? Thanks, Oliver Brandt
reference: Invoices are due within 14 days of the invoice date. We accept bank transfer and card payments but not cash.

subject: Moving from my current accountant
body:
Hi, I'm not happy with how slow my current accountant is and would like to move to you. Is there a charge for switching and do I have to deal with them myself?

Chloe
reference: There is no charge for switching. Once the engagement letter is signed we write to the previous accountant for professional clearance and collect the records; you do not need to contact them yourself.

subject: Initial consultation
body:
Hello,

I'd like to book an initial chat about taking on an accountant for my new online shop. Is the first meeting free, and can it be done over video as I'm in Reading?

Many thanks,
Hannah Lowe
reference: The first 20-minute call is free, by phone or video (Teams or Google Meet). Book by phone, email or online at wrenfield.example/book.

subject: Need to cancel tomorrow
body:
Hi, I've got the year-end review booked for tomorrow at 10 but something's come up at work. Can I cancel? Will there be a charge? You can call me on 07700 900456.

Ryan
reference: We ask for at least 24 hours' notice. A year-end review cancelled with less than 24 hours' notice is charged at £40. Offer to rebook.

subject: Evening appointments?
body: Do you offer any appointments after 5.30pm? I can't get away from work during the day. Megan
reference: Evening slots are available on Tuesday and Thursday until 19:00 by arrangement. Saturday mornings 9:00 to 13:00 are also possible by prior arrangement.

subject: Video meeting
body: Hi, can our year-end meeting be a video call instead of in person? Which platform do you use? Thanks, Kwame
reference: Yes, meetings can be on Microsoft Teams or Google Meet; we send the link with the booking confirmation.

subject: Parking
body:
I have a meeting with you on Thursday. Is there parking at your office?

Isabel
reference: There are 2 visitor spaces outside the office; otherwise use the Riverside car park next door and we validate 2 hours of parking at reception. The office is a 5-minute walk from Guildford station.

subject: Saturday?
body: Can I come in on a Saturday? Weekdays are impossible for me. Jack
reference: Saturday appointments are available from 9:00 to 13:00 by prior arrangement only. Book by phone, email or online.

subject: Rescheduling my appointment
body:
Hi,

I have an appointment booked for Tuesday 27 October at 14:00 but I need to move it to the following week. Could you let me know what's available? My number is +44 7700 900789 if easier.

Thanks,
Nina Petrova
14 Orchard Close
Guildford GU2 7XY
reference: Happy to move the meeting; 24 hours' notice is all we need. Suggest booking online to see live availability or offer to call.

subject: Where are you?
body: What's your address for a meeting and how far from the station? George
reference: Unit 4, Riverside Court, Guildford, GU1 9ZZ, a 5-minute walk from Guildford railway station.

subject: New client - what do I need to bring?
body:
Hi,

I've just gone self-employed as a dog groomer and I'd like you to do my first tax return. What documents do I need to bring to the first meeting? I live at 22 Hillside Road, Guildford GU4 8AB if that matters.

Thanks so much,
Emily
reference: Photo ID and proof of address for the identity checks, your UTR and NI number, and for the business: sales invoices, expense receipts and bank statements for the tax year. The engagement letter is signed through the portal.

subject: Ltd company handover
body:
We're moving our limited company to you from another firm. What do you need from us to get started on this year's accounts?

Dan Hughes
Hughes Joinery Ltd
reference: Certificate of incorporation and the Companies House authentication code, last year's accounts and CT computation, VAT number, bank statements for the year, invoices and receipts or bookkeeping software access, payroll records and details of loans or assets. We also need photo ID and proof of address for the directors.

subject: Uploading a big file
body: I'm trying to upload my bank statements to the portal but the file is 30MB and it won't go. What's the limit? Fatima
reference: The portal accepts files up to 25 MB each with no limit on the number of files, so split the statements into 2 files or upload them month by month.

subject: Paper records
body: I'm not great with computers. Can I just post you my receipts and bank statements? Lucas
reference: Yes, by post or by hand to Unit 4, Riverside Court, Guildford, GU1 9ZZ. We scan paper records and return them at your next visit or by post on request.

subject: Lost my P60
body: I can't find my P60 for last year, I think it got thrown out when we moved. Does that stop you doing my return? Amelia
reference: No. Your employer can give you a copy of the P60, or you can take the figures from your HMRC personal tax account online.

subject: File types
body: Which file types does the portal accept? I have photos of receipts on my iPhone (HEIC) and a spreadsheet. Noah
reference: PDF, JPG, PNG, HEIC, XLSX, CSV and DOCX, up to 25 MB per file. Phone photos are fine if the figures are readable.

subject: Is the portal safe?
body: Before I upload my passport I want to know how secure the portal is. Where is the data stored? Grace
reference: The portal uses two-factor authentication, data is stored in UK data centres encrypted in transit and at rest, and staff access is logged.

subject: Bank statements
body:
Hi, I've attached my bank statements for the year. My NI number is QQ 12 34 56 C and my UTR is 1234567890 in case you need them. Is email ok or should I use the portal?

Harry
reference: Email attachments are fine up to 20 MB in total, but the portal is preferred and is the safer route for anything with personal details.

subject: Payroll and pensions
body: We're taking on our first 2 employees next month. Can you run payroll and sort out the workplace pension thing? Sophie
reference: Yes: payroll is £25 per month for up to 5 employees including RTI submissions and P60s, and auto-enrolment pension set-up is £150 one-off.

subject: Software
body: I currently use QuickBooks. Do you work with that or would I have to move to something else? Arjun
reference: We support QuickBooks Online as well as Xero (our preferred platform) and FreeAgent, so no need to move.

subject: Making Tax Digital
body: I'm a self-employed consultant earning around £70k. I keep hearing about Making Tax Digital. Does it apply to me and can you handle it? Ella
reference: From April 2026 self-employed people with gross income over £50,000 must keep digital records and send quarterly updates, so at £70,000 it applies. We set up the software and send the quarterly updates as part of bookkeeping. Check gov.uk for current thresholds.

subject: Selling a flat
body: I'm selling a flat I used to rent out. I've heard there's a short deadline to report the gain. Do you do this? Louis
reference: Yes. A UK residential property that is not your main home must be reported and the tax paid within 60 days of completion. We prepare and file the 60-day return, from £120 when added to an existing Self Assessment engagement.

subject: Management accounts
body: Our bank wants quarterly management accounts for a loan. Is that something you do and what does it cost? Zara
reference: Yes, quarterly management accounts (profit and loss, balance sheet, short commentary) from £200 per quarter plus VAT.

subject: Registered office
body: I don't want my home address on Companies House. Can I use yours and what's the fee? Freddie
reference: Yes, the registered office address service is £120 per year.

subject: Clients outside Surrey
body: I'm in Manchester. Do you take on clients who aren't local? Maya
reference: Yes, about a third of our clients are elsewhere in the UK and work with us through the portal, video calls and phone.

subject: Deadline for my tax return
body:
Hi,

When is the deadline for filing my Self Assessment online, and when do I need to get my paperwork to you to be safe?

Thanks,
Charlotte
reference: The online return and payment are due by 31 January. Send complete records at least 4 weeks before, so by 31 December, to guarantee filing on time.

subject: Company year end
body: Our company year end is 31 March. When do the accounts have to be filed and when is the corporation tax due? Ethan
reference: Accounts go to Companies House 9 months after the year end, corporation tax is paid 9 months and 1 day after, and the CT600 is due 12 months after the year end.

subject: VAT due date
body: My VAT quarter ended 30 September. When is the return due? Olivia
reference: VAT returns and payment are due 1 month and 7 days after the end of the period. Direct Debit payments are collected 3 working days after the deadline.

subject: Registering for self assessment
body: I started doing some freelance work on the side in May. When do I have to register with HMRC? Alfie
reference: Register for Self Assessment by 5 October following the end of the tax year in which you first had untaxed income.

subject: Payments on account
body: You mentioned payments on account in my letter. When are they due? Ruby
reference: Payments on account are due on 31 January and 31 July, usually when the bill is over £1,000.

subject: Penalty because of YOUR delay
body:
I sent you everything in November and you still filed my return late. Now I have a £100 penalty from HMRC. This is unacceptable and I expect you to pay it. I want a response today.

Martin Blake
reference: Escalate to a person. Any reply should acknowledge the complaint, explain it is being handled under the complaints policy (acknowledged within 2 working days, full response within 10) and not argue the facts.

subject: Invoice 2291 is wrong
body: Your invoice 2291 is for £540 but we agreed £300 for the sole trader accounts. I'm not paying this until it's sorted. Karen
reference: Escalate to a person. A fee in dispute is not chased while under review.

subject: Mistake in the accounts
body: The accounts you sent show turnover of 212k but it was 121k, you've transposed the figures. I'm worried this has gone to Companies House. Please check urgently. Steve
reference: Escalate to a person immediately; do not confirm or deny the error.

subject: Still waiting
body: I emailed two weeks ago about my refund and nobody has replied. I'm really disappointed with the service. Linda
reference: Escalate to a person: a complaint about service, and a refund question that needs the client's file.

subject: US tax return
body:
Hi, I'm a dual UK/US citizen and need my US return (1040) done as well as the UK one. Can you do both?

Paul Weston
reference: We do not prepare tax returns for countries other than the UK; we can suggest an overseas specialist. The UK return we can do.

subject: Trainee accountant position
body:
Dear Sir/Madam,

I am a recent AAT graduate and would like to apply for a trainee position at your firm. Please find my CV attached. I'm available for interview at any time.

Yours faithfully,
Jessica Lane
reference: Not covered by the documents; pass to a person.

subject: Crypto
body: I traded quite a lot of crypto last year across a few exchanges. Do you do the gains calculations for that? Ahmed
reference: The documents do not say whether we handle cryptoasset calculations; pass to a person rather than guess.

subject: Letter from HMRC
body:
I've received a letter from HMRC saying they are opening an enquiry into my 2024/25 return. I'm quite worried. What do I do?

Victoria
reference: A person must handle an HMRC enquiry. Reassure and promise a call.

subject: Double your leads with SEO
body: Hi Wrenfield team, I noticed your website isn't ranking for 'accountant Guildford'. We help firms like yours get 3x more leads in 90 days. Can I send you a free audit? Best, Mike
reference: Sales pitch, not an enquiry. No reply needed; pass to a person or ignore.

subject: How much tax will I owe?
body: I'm self-employed and made about £62,000 profit this year. Roughly how much tax and NI will I have to pay in January? Marco
reference: Personal tax advice: a person must answer. Offer a free 20-minute call.
